name: Ibutamoren

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A non-peptide orally active growth hormone secretagogue at the ghrelin receptor. It was investigated clinically and never approved; it is sold for laboratory research use and is prohibited in sport. Investigated and never approved. No FDA label exists.

systems.note: Ghrelin receptor agonism raising pulsatile GH and IGF-1; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Sought for lean mass and appetite; fluid retention is a recognised trial effect.
Trials show rising fasting glucose and falling insulin sensitivity.
Fluid retention and reports of raised heart failure risk in an older trial population.

monitors.why: The index of achieved GH exposure; no approved dosing reference exists.
Integrated glycaemic effect of sustained GH elevation.
